notes.headline: Contoso EV announces a Spanish roadshow starting 2 November
notes.summary: Contoso EV has announced a roadshow in Madrid and Barcelona from 2 to 15 November 2026, supported by a new digital media campaign in Spain.
notes.meetingPrompt: Discuss the upcoming launch when reviewing next-quarter planning, without assuming the Q3 credit has been approved or issued.

notes.headline: Litware Home's UK autumn campaign opens on 26 October
notes.summary: Litware Home has announced an autumn promotion across its UK stores and online shop from 26 October to 8 November 2026, with a new wave of retail media activity.
notes.meetingPrompt: Confirm the separate Q4 plan and budget for the autumn campaign; do not treat Q3 extra delivery as a credit or carry-over.
